basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Solutions Architect | Production Agentic Systems on AWS & GCP | Technical Advisor & Speaker
basics.summary: Zurich-based AI engineer and technical advisor with 13+ years shipping production systems for enterprise customers on AWS. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building multi-agent workflows (LangGraph, ADK, Bedrock/Vertex, MCP) that 2x sales conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. Six years at Beekeeper on AWS/Kubernetes/Kafka, including LLM pipelines that eliminated $337K in vendor cost and a search platform serving 10M+ frontline users. Frequent speaker (Front Conference, Developer Week USA) and published on the AWS Public Sector Blog. Regularly runs technical deep-dives, PoCs and enablement for startups (Tenity panelist) and my own AI product portfolio at Anand Creations.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Designed and shipped production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on Vertex AI) using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI via AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M approved opportunities per quarter, $1M in revenue.

Architected AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts and product usage into one time-aware memory. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, per-agent read/write contracts, and a freshness layer that grounds RAG retrieval and cuts hallucinations.

Own the full delivery lifecycle: agent architecture, MLOps (eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request telemetry) and global on-call. Report directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation cost with an in-house LLM pipeline (OpenAI + GitHub Actions on AWS) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end on AWS/Kubernetes/PostgreSQL. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist and GenAI demo generator using OpenAI, Claude, CrewAI and Strands Agents on AWS. 100% of new signups guided through setup; sales demos auto-personalized from Salesforce data.

Ran observability and on-call for global production systems on AWS (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Kafka, Elastic Search); mentored the AI engineering cohort and co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Trusted technical advisor to 20+ seed-to-VC fintech and AI startups: evaluated architecture, scalability, cloud posture and AI readiness to inform investment decisions.
Ran technical deep-dives and enablement sessions on cloud AI adoption; mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped an end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform on AWS (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD from scratch) that ran 500+ real-world deliveries and enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and neural controllers via genetic algorithms. Foundational ML work (optimization, search, fitness landscapes) that underpins today's agentic craft.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics; supervised 20+ MSc students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers and embodied AI.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months on AWS, 40% uplift in user satisfaction. Regulated fintech domain.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence platform. AI agents generate and justify trading signals from technical and news data with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Serving live retail users on real-time feeds.
